subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Counterfeit
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"counterfeit"** means something that is made in exact imitation of something valuable with the intention to deceive or defraud; fake or false. (नकली)

 
 
• **Example: **The police seized a large quantity of **counterfeit **currency from the suspect's house.
 
 
 
• **"Authentic" **refers to something that is genuine, real, and not a copy; it is trustworthy and reliable. (प्रामाणिक)
 
 
• **Example: **The museum has an **authentic** painting by Vincent van Gogh.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'counterfeit' **is **'authentic'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Unreal **(अवास्तविक): Something that is not real or imaginary.

 
 
• **Example: **The landscape in the painting looked so surreal and** unreal.**
 
 
 
• **Fake **(नकली): An imitation or forgery intended to deceive.
 
 
• **Example: **She realized that the designer handbag she bought was** fake.**
 
 
 
• **Imitation** (अनुकरण): A copy or reproduction of something.
 
 
• **Example: **He bought an** imitation** watch that looked like an expensive brand.
 
 

187:Tb48,

The correct answer is: Option 3.&l
